per_question.question: What is the average payment-term length across all our supplier contracts?
per_question.answer:
The payment terms across the supplier contracts are as follows:

1. [Standard Purchase Terms - Net 30]: Payment is due within 30 days of invoice date [Standard Purchase Terms - Net 30].
2. [CON-2026-00025]: Payment is due within 45 days of invoice date (Net 45) [CON-2026-00025].
3. [CON-2026-00024]: Payment is due within 45 days of invoice date (Net 45) [CON-2026-00024].
4. [CON-2026-00048]: Payment is due within 30 days of invoice date (Net 30) [CON-2026-00048].

To calculate the average payment-term length:
- Net 30 appears twice.
- Net 45 appears twice.

Average = (30 + 45 + 45 + 30) / 4 = 37.5 days

The average payment-term length across all supplier contracts is 37.5 days.
